//: Capability manifest for textarea/1 (the .pa-textarea control) — keen-pure-admin. textarea/1 renders <textarea name id class={textarea_classes} {@rest}><%= @value %></textarea>. Size + themeColor(→color) are the only class axes (core has NO textarea validation-state border — keen's textarea_classes drops `validation`, so it is NOT mapped). value is the text content; placeholder/disabled/readonly/required ride in :global :rest with STRING keys so they only emit when present (maybe_put drops nil/false). color is nativeType string. `rows` is NOT mapped (keen routes it via rest — only appears when supplied; the oracle golden carries none).
